summary: Full e2e test of the SIH 26123 AMR Fleet app. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (GET /api/, POST+GET /api/demo-requests, POST+GET /api/sim-runs, validation 422s, CORS, no _id leakage, Mongo persistence verified via Create->GET). Frontend: landing page (live auto-ticking hero grid, all sections, Request Demo form -> success toast -> row persisted), navigation both ways, and the whole mission-control dashboard were tested with real Playwright clicks. IMPORTANT: the main agent's reported 'clicks not reaching React handlers' is NOT reproducible - every control (nav links, Play/Step/Reset, scenario cards, tabs, add/remove/kill/recover, inject, block, regenerate, indicators, roster rows, grid cells, demo-mode toggle, CSV export) responded correctly to normal (non-forced) Playwright clicks. That was a screenshot-tool artifact only. All 9 scenarios load and produce the expected events except blocked_noalt (0 reallocations). One real HIGH-priority layout bug found: TaskManagerPanel/BatteryPanel use h-full and overflow their grid row by ~758px, bleeding the neon battery bars over the Performance panel text and creating a large dead zone below the footer.

minor.issue: email is a plain str with no format validation - 'not-an-email' is accepted. Consider pydantic EmailStr.
Return 200 on create instead of 201 (cosmetic REST nit).
Leftover boilerplate StatusCheck endpoints unused by this app - dead code, consider removing.

ui_bugs.issue: HIGH: Both panels are rendered with className="h-full" inside a grid column that has no explicit height, so each resolves to the full grid-row height (747px). Measured at 1920x1080: tm-panel y=227..973 (h=747) and battery-panel y=985..1732 (h=747) while the grid row is only 747px tall. The right column therefore overflows the row by ~758px. Consequences: (1) the Battery Overview panel's neon-green (#39FF14) battery bars render at x=1493..1850 / y=1093..1156, i.e. directly over the Performance panel body, making the 'Run a headless baseline... Rule A' placeholder text and the improvement callout numbers unreadable; (2) the panel keeps extending past footer-metrics (bottom 1732 vs footer bottom 1385) producing a large empty dark block plus a stray vertical border line at x~1180 down the bottom of the page; (3) the Battery Overview panel itself is effectively unusable. Only affects the lg breakpoint (>=1024px); 390px and 768px stack correctly with no overflow.

The Election History list filters events by category === "TM", but the engine logs non-election events under the same 'TM' category (engine.js:215 'Robot R9 joined the fleet at [..]', :222 'Cannot remove R3: minimum fleet size is 3', :231 'Robot R4 removed from fleet'). Fleet add/remove/blocked-removal messages therefore appear under 'ELECTION HISTORY', which is misleading. Use a dedicated category (e.g. 'Fleet') or filter on the tm/handover sub-kind.

Spec says removal below 3 robots should show a toast warning. AdminControls.jsx has toasts for add/kill/inject/block/regen but none for remove, so blocking is silent in the UI - the only feedback is the 'Cannot remove Rx: minimum fleet size is 3' line buried in the TM panel. Removal is correctly blocked (fleet stays at 3), just unannounced.

Minor/testability: Play and Pause share the single testid play-simulation-btn (label toggles PLAY/PAUSE correctly). There is no data-testid="pause-simulation-btn" as implied by the spec. Functionally fine; consider a stable state attribute (e.g. data-running) for tests.

integration_issues.flow: Scenario: Blocked Path (no alternate) -> task reallocation
integration_issues.issue: The scenario never triggers a reallocation, so its headline claim ('Dead-end block forces task reallocation') is not demonstrated. Over a 121-tick run: blocked/reroutes=40, reallocations=0, and no 'Task Reallocation' entry in the log. Root cause: useSimulation.applyScenario blocks only the mid cross-aisle cells (wh.aisleCols.map(x => [x, wh.midRow])); A*/D*-Lite in engine._stepMovement always finds an alternate route so _replan() succeeds and _releaseTask() (engine.js:754, the only path that increments indicators.reallocation for this scenario) is never reached. The reallocation mechanism itself works - the battery_dead scenario produced reallocation=1. Fix: block a genuine dead-end/enclosing cell set around the robot's goal, or force replan failure.

issues: Battery panel overflow overlays the Performance panel and leaves ~350px of empty page below the footer with a stray vertical border (same root cause as the HIGH ui_bug above)
Performance panel Recharts bar chart sits below the fold of its 340px row-mates, so the chart is partially cut off until the user scrolls

With the operator/roster panels hidden the Live Warehouse Grid stretches very tall, pushing the Event Log and Performance panel far below the fold - a presentation mode would ideally keep grid + log + metrics on one screen

critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx: 'h-full' on siblings inside an auto-height grid column is the exact cause of the 758px overflow - height:100% resolves against the grid row, so two h-full siblings always double the row height.
engine.js is 1217 lines - above the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into pathfinding / collision+deadlock / task-allocation / comms modules for maintainability.

useSimulation.js monkey-patches engine.step() inside a useEffect to install scenario triggers (eng.step = () => {...}). This is fragile: any second mount, StrictMode double-invoke, or reordering would wrap step twice. Prefer a first-class scheduled-events queue on the engine (e.g. engine.scheduleAt(tick, fn)).
PerformancePanel.run() swallows the /api/sim-runs POST failure silently (empty catch). Persistence failures are invisible to the operator - surface a toast so a broken backend is noticeable.
SidePanels.jsx:7 filters the TM log by category only; category 'TM' is overloaded for elections AND fleet membership changes, so the panel title lies about its contents.

rca_of_the_issue: Primary bug: Dashboard.jsx renders the right bento column as <div className="lg:col-span-3 order-3 space-y-3"> containing <TaskManagerPanel/> and <BatteryPanel/>, both of which pass className="h-full" to Panel. The column has no intrinsic height, so in the CSS grid it is stretched to the row height set by the tallest cell (the 747px Live Warehouse Grid). height:100% on each child then resolves to that same 747px, making the column content 747+12+747 = 1506px - a ~758px overflow. Because Panel sets overflow:visible and .panel's background is the semi-transparent var(--panel), the overflowing Battery Overview panel paints its bright #39FF14 battery bars through/over the Performance panel that occupies the next grid row (measured overlap: 465px x 340px), and continues past footer-metrics leaving dead space and a stray border. Reproduce: open /dashboard at 1920x1080, scroll to the Performance panel, observe 4 green bars over the placeholder/callout text; confirm with getBoundingClientRect on [data-testid="battery-panel"] (y 985..1732) vs [data-testid="performance-panel"] (y 985..1325). Mitigation: drop h-full from those two panels or convert the column to a flex column (h-full flex flex-col gap-3) with flex-1 min-h-0 children. Secondary bug: scenario blocked_noalt blocks only the mid cross-aisle, which never defeats A*/D*-Lite, so engine._replan always succeeds and _releaseTask (the reallocation trigger at engine.js:754) never fires - indicator-reallocation stays 0 and the scenario's stated outcome is never shown.
